description: Source code implementing key to character code conversion functions for different key states (with and without shift) in the starboard input namespace.

methods.name: KeyToCharCodeWithShift
methods.description: Converts a key to its shifted character code, handling special symbols and alphabetic keys.

methods.name: KeyToCharCodeNoShift
methods.description: Converts a key to its unshifted character code, mapping uppercase to lowercase and handling symbols.

methods.name: ComputeCharCode
methods.description: Determines whether to use shifted or unshifted conversion based on modifiers and returns the corresponding character code.
